# Back matter

The second index's cross-reference, whose target only the first index marks:
[Solute]{.index index="second" see="Solvent"}.

The rival key for the printed path the second index already files under
`Aaa`: [Rival]{.index index="second" sort="Zzz"}.

The closing of the range the opening chapter opened in the second index, which
is the one pair this book has to name:
[Bridge]{.index index="second" range="close"}.

The closing of the twin range, written in the second index while its opening
was written in the first:
[Crossed]{.index index="second" range="close"}.
